name: Gold Pride - Start Your Engines!
card_text: If your opponent Normal or Special Summons a monster(s): Target 1 of those monsters; reveal 3 "Gold Pride" monsters from your Deck, your opponent randomly picks 1 for you to Special Summon, shuffle the rest into your Deck, then destroy the targeted monster.
